messages.subject: DEC Analysis Error
parts:
Hi Nick,

I have been following your example script of Psychotria to run a DEC on some Neoceratopsians, however, when I start the analysis I receive the following error.

 runslow = TRUE
> resfn = "Neoceratopsia_DEC.Rdata"
> if (runslow)
+ {
+     res = bears_optim_run(BioGeoBEARS_run_object)
+     res    
+     
+     save(res, file=resfn)
+     resDEC = res
+ } else {
+     # Loads to "res"
+     load(resfn)
+     resDEC = res
+ }
Read 6 items
Read 82 items
Error in if (sum(blren_equal_below_0_TF) > 0) { : 
  missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed

Any insight would be incredibly helpful.

Thanks in advance!

Tyler

messages.author: 115d05260b0c341a
messages.subject: Re: [BioGeoBEARS] DEC Analysis Error
parts:
Hi,

This line:

if (sum(blren_equal_below_0_TF) > 0) { : 

...is from an error-check part of the code that counts ("sum") the number of times it is TRUE (TF = true/false) that a branch length is less than 0.

Obviously, branch-lengths less than zero are Very Bad, but they are sometimes produced by e.g. the MCC summary trees produced by TreeAnnotator in a Beast analysis -- they have to be manually fixed, google "negative branch lengths phylowiki" to see my advice.

In your case, though, you get "missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed" -- this suggests that there may be no branchlengths at all in your tree, which would be a big problem.  This could happen if you took e.g. a non-dated cladogram and tried to run it in BioGeoBEARS.

So, check your tree, look at it in FigTree, and try again.

Also, make sure you are using the GitHub version of BioGeoBEARS.

Cheers,
Nick
